scope: No-training bootstrap report for scratch Detector 0 localization and crop normalization.

m3ae_k_split_overlap.coarse_source_id_overlap: expected popsign-v1-original-videos overlap only; not clip/source-record leakage

blocker_classification.reason: The crop-identity-preserving recognizer memorized train, validation/test remained near random, and M3AE-K found no clip/source-record/signer/tensor leakage across splits.

api_memo_summary.recommendation: Split recognition into composable scratch localization/crop-normalization and classifier stages before more classifier tuning.
api_memo_summary.local_evidence_binding: M3AE-I/J/K show fixed crops can be fit on train but do not generalize under signer-disjoint PopSign validation/test.

detector0_target_schema.coordinate_space: normalized full-frame xyxy coordinates with origin at top-left; values must be in [0, 1]

target_groups.semantic_role: viewer-left hand when both hands are visible; first visible signing hand when only one hand is present
viewer-right hand when both hands are visible; second visible signing hand when two hands are present
head/face box for head-contact signs and crop scale normalization
upper-body/signing-space context box used to normalize scale and retain torso context

allowed_label_sources.description: Human-authored boxes and centers on approved PopSign raw frames or decoded tensor frames retained in this repo.
Labels initialized from existing fixed-crop/contact-sheet context only after human verification and explicit review_status=manual_verified.
Existing contact sheets may select or review frames, but do not become labels without human annotation or verification.
Existing M3AD manifests, source ids, source record ids, tensor hashes, signer hashes, and crop config hashes bind annotation rows to approved data.

disallowed_label_sources: preview videos or derived non-raw PopSign artifacts
source_register_checks: annotation rows must point to source_id=popsign-v1-original-videos unless a future source-register decision explicitly expands the lane
packet validation must reject broad asl-citizen, broad wlasl, preview-video, pose, landmark, embedding, detector, and feature artifacts

minimum_seed_packet_shape.target_per_label_split: at least 2 clips per label per split, with 4 temporally spaced frames per clip before any detector training smoke
minimum_seed_packet_shape.heldout_requirement: validation and test annotation rows must remain held out from detector optimization and be used only for localization gates

no_pretrained_constraints.promoted_lane_requirement: Detector 0 and downstream crop normalization must be scratch-trained or manually specified; no pretrained CV, sign, landmark, pose, detector, feature extractor, or backbone may produce labels or model weights.
required_receipts_before_detector_traini: packet JSON validates and binds source/crop/manifest hashes
annotation packet contains only allowed annotation_source values

heldout_visible_target_localization.center_error_gate: for visible hands/head targets, at least 80% of held-out annotated frames per target group must have center error <= 0.12 normalized frame diagonal
heldout_visible_target_localization.box_iou_gate: hands and head_or_face must reach median IoU >= 0.35 on held-out visible targets; upper_body_or_signing_space must reach median IoU >= 0.50

no_pretrained_provenance.pass_condition: detector training report records pretrained_components=[], allowed annotation sources only, and passing no-pretrained audits

temporal_stability.pass_condition: for unoccluded consecutive sampled frames, median target-center jitter <= 0.15 normalized frame diagonal and no unflagged box-area jump greater than 2x within a clip

visual_overlay_review.pass_condition: overlay sheets exist for held-out annotated clips, reviewer marks at least 80% target rows acceptable, and no systematic unflagged hand/head misses remain for dad, grandpa, or hat

fixed_vs_detector_crop_ablation.design: after Detector 0 passes localization gates, generate detector-normalized crops for the same Tier 0 train/validation/test manifests and compare one recognizer run against the retained M3AE-J fixed-crop baseline with identical labels, splits, source ids, and no pretrained components
fixed_vs_detector_crop_ablation.minimum_useful_improvement: detector-normalized recognizer must preserve train sanity and improve validation top1 or macro recall by at least 0.10 absolute over M3AE-J, or remove zero-recall validation/test labels without creating new zero-recall labels
fixed_vs_detector_crop_ablation.non_promotion_rule: do not make detector crops primary unless localization gates and the fixed-vs-detector ablation both pass

detector_failure: held-out visible hand/head localization misses the center or IoU gates after the first scratch detector smoke
temporal stability or visual overlay review shows systematic unflagged misses on head-region signs
detector training requires pretrained weights, pretrained-generated labels, or unapproved source media
annotation_insufficiency: manual or manual-verified packet cannot cover all five selected labels across train plus held-out validation/test rows
annotation rows cannot bind back to approved PopSign source records and tensor hashes
review status remains unreviewed or uses unknown/generated label provenance
unchanged_recognizer_generalization_afte: after localization gates pass, the fixed-vs-detector ablation still reports validation/test near random
zero-recall validation or test labels persist without a new concrete crop/localization failure
the next meaningful change would require source approval, human data collection, final-gate changes, or a reduced product claim

hard_negative_and_calibration_blockers.hard_negative_far: not assessed; no classifier threshold, hard-negative set, ONNX export, or model-card promotion is part of M3AE-L
hard_negative_and_calibration_blockers.no_zero_accepted_true_class: not assessed; no acceptance threshold exists in this bootstrap report
hard_negative_and_calibration_blockers.final_promotion_negative_challenge_block: unchanged; ./.venv/bin/python scripts/audit_final_manifests.py still remains the separate final-promotion negative-challenge gate and is not weakened by this Detector 0 bootstrap

next_action.description: Create or populate the manual/manual-verified localization annotation packet at data/annotations/detector0/return-to-form-tier0-localization-packet-v0.json, bind it to the existing Tier 0 manifests/source/crop hashes, and validate provenance before any Detector 0 training.
